title: Meta to buy up to $6B of fiber optic products from Corning

sources.quote: Corning and Meta Announce Multiyear, Up to $6-Billion Agreement
Meta, USA, and Corning, USA, have entered into a multiyear, up to US$6 billion partnership designed to advance the construction of cutting-edge data center infrastructure across the United States.

explain: Meta agreed to buy optical fiber, cable and connectors from Corning for its US AI data centers over several years, worth up to $6 billion. 'Up to' means $6 billion is a ceiling, not a guaranteed total. Corning is expanding its North Carolina factories to fill the order.
